skill.summary: 为小红书文案生成不同风格的知识卡片附图（如 Mac Pro、赛博朋克、包豪斯风）。当用户需要将 Markdown 文案渲染成美观的图片卡片时使用。支持自动分段渲染封面和详情页。

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of card-renderer skill.

- Generates visually styled knowledge cards for Xiaohongshu content from Markdown or text files.
- Supports multiple design themes: Mac Pro, Cyberpunk, Bauhaus, Vintage, Dreamy, VS Code, Polaroid, Magazine, Minimal Grid, Split Color, Framed Minimal.
- Automatically paginates content into cover and details images.
- Unified script calling interface for all styles.
- Provides clear guidance on expanding with new style scripts.
- Requires Pillow and macOS system fonts; outputs 1080x1440 images with preview support.
